raw_text: PLAN warships confirmed docked at Hambantota. Two vessels, one Type 054A frigate. Five-day visit. Colombo sources say Sri Lankan Navy facilitated the visit as part of standing bilateral naval cooperation. Indian High Commission reportedly sought clarification. This is the second such visit in 2024.
